name: Boots of Dazzling Danger
text:
These stylish yet menacing thigh-high heeled boots sparkle with tiny glass gems and feature silver studs shaped like scorpion claws that wrap around the toe. On the back, a silver stinger acts as a decorative spur. You gain a +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks while wearing the boots.

Activate—Startling Stinger 2 (emotion, fear, illusion, manipulate, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You tap the toes of the boots together, causing an illusory scorpion to peel away from each. Creatures adjacent to you must attempt a DC 25 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is frightened 1 and Fleeing for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 2 and fleeing for as long as it remains frightened.
